consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Dependent on absorbency of the substrate as well as the required penetration depth: ~ 150 g/m2 per coat.

coats.label: System structure
coats.text: 2–3 coats either as stand alone or combined with surface applied corrosion inhibitor and/or protective coating.

recoat_times.label: Waiting time to overcoating
recoat_times.text: Waiting time: Minimum 5 hours, maximum 1 week.

parsed.note: several durations in one statement; the datasheet columns are not labelled in the text, read the phrase

compat.text: Sikagard®-705 L is used as water-repellent impregnation (hydrophobic treatment) for absorbent substrates such as concrete in civil engineering or building concrete structures subjected to heavy stress due to freeze and thaw cycles and de-icing salts and chloride attack in marine environment Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.1 of EN 1504-9),
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Areas not to be impregnated such as window panes need to be protected from being accidentally contaminated with Sikagard®-705 L.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Take necessary action to avoid static electricity discharge (which might cause ignition of organic vapours). Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours. Avoid vapor formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where vapor is formed.
